title: veronica serpyllifolia subsp. parvifolia
intro: Veronica serpyllifolia subsp. parvifolia, commonly known as Small-leaved Speedwell, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Veronica serpyllifolia subsp. parvifolia include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial activities, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and infections. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
